quarterly_data.signal: MediaTek launched the Dimensity 9600 Pro flagship smartphone SoC on a 2nm process node; MediaTek claims to be the first company to announce reaching this threshold. It uses a 2+3+3 All Big Core CPU (two C2-Ultra cores up to 4.55GHz, three C2-Pro cores at 4.35GHz, three C2-Pro cores at 3.1GHz) with a company-stated 61% reduction in multi-core power consumption and up to 17% higher single-core / 15% higher multi-core performance versus the previous generation; the NPU 1090 delivers 51% higher LLM prefill performance and supports on-device models up to 30B parameters; a 34.5MB cache and, for the first time, LPDDR6 memory and UFS 5.0 storage; G2-Ultra NX GPU with up to 27% higher peak performance. MediaTek also introduced the Dimensity 9600M. The first smartphones powered by the Dimensity 9600 Pro and Dimensity 9600M are expected to launch this quarter. Foundry and customers not named.
quarterly_data.figure: 2nm; CPU up to 4.55GHz; 61% lower multi-core power; up to 17% single-core / 15% multi-core uplift; models up to 30B parameters; 34.5MB cache; GPU up to 27% higher peak performance
